targets.rawSql: SELECT station_id, avg(oee) as avg_oee FROM primeev_telemetry.oee_metrics WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY station_id ORDER BY station_id

SELECT toStartOfHour(timestamp) as time, station_id, avg(value) as avg_temp FROM primeev_telemetry.sensor_readings WHERE sensor_type = 'TMP' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY time, station_id ORDER BY time
SELECT toDate(timestamp) as date, sum(oee) as daily_oee FROM primeev_telemetry.oee_metrics GROUP BY date ORDER BY date
